title: Palace Orchestrator
hero_prompt: Wide ~12:5 banner in Constructivist printmaking idiom — bold hand-cut linocut style, limited palette of deep red, black, and cream. One dominant scene: a large open book or page at center-left rising up and transforming into an angular geometric human-abstract figure mid-stride, arms raised in dispatch, radiating hard-edged rays and gear-like cogs outward across the composition. Diagonal compositional axes, strong geometric shapes, overlapping angular planes, mechanical rhythm. Hand-printed texture, visible carving marks, slight ink imperfection. Purely pictorial, no letters, no numerals, no words, no labels anywhere. One dominant metaphor, legible when darkened and desaturated as a backdrop.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast Constructivist linocut emblem, square, survives at 24–48px. A single stark silhouette: an angular geometric figure emerging from a rectangular page, one arm thrust forward in a dispatch gesture, radiating three thick hard-edged rays. Deep red and black on cream, heavy shapes only, no fine linework, no gradients, strong silhouette. Purely pictorial, no letters, no numerals, no words, no labels.
